title: Women in Academic Science: A Changing Landscape
notes: OK (counterpoint: parity once hired in math-intensive fields). Abstract: of those who obtain doctorates in math-intensive fields, men and women entering the professoriate have equivalent access to tenure-track jobs and persist and are remunerated at comparable rates; female PhD applicants fare at least as well in interviews/offers; more pipeline leakage in fields where women are already prevalent.
